name: Quick Keys: Tag, Move, Mark
description: Keyboard shortcuts for fast inbox triage: tag or move the selected messages by typing a few letters, mark read or unread, and press F1 for hints.
author: pandincus

pick-tag.description: Tag the selected messages: type part of a tag name, Enter to toggle it

pick-move.description: Move the selected messages: type part of a folder name, Enter to move

mark-read.description: Mark the selected messages as read

mark-unread.description: Mark the selected messages as unread

show-help.description: Show the list of Quick Keys shortcuts
